event_description: Statewide flood preparation emergency order for record snowpack, teams sent to high-risk counties

Disaster declaration for flooding from rain and record snowmelt, with landslides and saturated farmland, in Crook, Carbon, Albany, Lincoln and Sheridan counties (an emergency executive order had activated the State Operations Center on May 27, 2011).
Statewide emergency for a propane shortage caused by extreme cold
Declaration of emergency for flooding and mudslides in Niobrara and Johnson counties and road closures near Cody, in Wind River Canyon and on Togwotee Pass.
Executive order declaring an emergency for severe weather and flooding from river ice jams in Fremont, Teton and Washakie counties.
Statewide emergency for propane supply during exceptionally cold conditions
Statewide emergency for fuel delivery during an early and severe wildfire season
Statewide emergency for a propane shortage during cold temperatures
Statewide emergency for widespread wildfires (House Draw, Constitution, Remington and Flat Rock fires)
